# Paire

> Paire (paire.in) is an Indian dating app for men and women (18+) where women set the rules. Every like can carry a short note, Paire Plus reveals who likes you, and there are no caste filters. It covers everything from casual dating to marriage-minded relationships. Tagline: "Find your Paire."

Paire launched in 2026, open to men and women across India. It runs in any phone or laptop browser at https://www.paire.in/app/ with Google or email sign-in; an Android app is coming.

## Key facts

- Who it's for: adult men and women, 18+. Men see women and women see men by default ("Show me" can be changed).
- Free for everyone: 10 likes a day (each can carry a note), 1 Super Like a day, an anonymous likes preview, mutual matching, reading messages, all privacy and safety controls.
- Sending messages needs your own Paire Plus pass (messaging is included while it runs) or Unlimited Chat: a one-time ₹70 unlock for all current and future mutual matches, with no expiry, renewal or per-match charge. Each person needs their own access to send.
- Paire Plus regular totals: ₹49 for 24 hours, ₹150 for 7 days, ₹570 for 60 days (30 paid days plus 30 bonus days), ₹1,141.43 for 180 days, ₹1,499 for Annual Plus (365 days), or ₹2,141.43 for Lifetime Plus while the service operates on that account. All payments are one-time, taxes included, with no auto-renewal.
- Eligible members without active Plus receive 50% off: Annual Plus ₹749.50, Lifetime Plus ₹1,070.72, or Monthly Plus ₹285 for 60 days. The fixed seven-day deadline starts at first eligibility; unexpired older offers upgrade without resetting it, and expired offers stay expired. The app checks eligibility and the exact total before payment through KraftAI and Razorpay. Active Plus members may extend at regular prices. Previously issued orders keep their own prices; gift and other payment-method prices are separate.
- All Plus passes reveal who likes you, include messaging with mutual matches, 5 Super Likes daily, priority likes and the age-gap filter. Monthly, six-month, annual and lifetime plans include unlimited regular likes; day/week passes include 100 regular likes daily. Paying never guarantees a match or reply. Lifetime remains tied to one account, subject to refund and community terms.
- Women-first controls (free): notes-only likes, "I'll message first", incognito (only people you like can see you), private photos until you match, "same intentions only", "speaks my language".
- Trust signals: confirmed email is required before likes/chat, and known disposable inboxes are blocked. Photo verification is separate and is not currently required for every profile; look for a current photo-check badge. Work-sector badges are self-declared and do not verify employment or qualifications. No badge guarantees identity or intentions.
- Safety: report and block in every chat, Paire AI warnings for money, OTP and scam messages, moderation of reported profiles. Paid arrangements and money requests are banned.
- India-specific: optional basics (height, languages, education, diet, drinking, smoking, religion); religion is never used to filter or rank; no caste field or filter.
- Discovery modes: People (photo cards), Vibe First (interests and intentions before photos), Duos (date together with a best friend), blind date mode.
- Diwali Together: a voluntary Diwali 2026 edition for adults away from home, open 24 October to 10 November 2026 (India time), with planning days 5–10 November and Diwali on Sunday 8 November. Members choose up to three days and three public plans (chai & mithai, mela stroll, lights walk, café meal, Diwali bash) and see nearby members with a matching day and plan. Matching is mutual only. Paire does not host or organise events and cannot promise matches; other members never see exact dates. Joining and matching are free; sending messages follows Paire's normal rules. Describe it as ended after 10 November 2026. The earlier Garba Nights edition (11–20 October 2026) has ended.
- Paire AI: icebreakers, bio ideas, optional AI vibe matching (opt-in, uses only selected profile choices) and chat-safety checks.

## How Paire compares

- Likes reveal: Paire Plus shows pending liker profiles and notes. Free members see an anonymous count, including likes outside their search filters.
- Versus subscription apps: Paire Plus is a pass from ₹49 that ends by itself, with no auto-renewal.
- Versus matrimonial sites: Paire covers marriage-minded dating too ("same intentions only"), without caste filters or family-run profiles.
